people.imagined: Dusk on the coal road with the baskets coming up; he counts one more basket on the cord at his wrist and looks at the sky, expecting rain.
people.subject: The moment: dusk on the coal road below the forge; he has just counted one more basket on the knotted cord at his wrist and glances at the sky, expecting rain, then turns grave eyes on the viewer. Face: a long, honest, sun-lined face of forty-six; grey-green eyes squinting up at weather; a stubborn square chin; thin lips pressed; a short brown beard flecked with grey; deep red pressure-marks at the open collar where basket straps have bitten for thirty years. Hair: brown going grey, tied low at the neck with a strip of black silk cord. Body: tall, spare, shoulders bowed under a long habit of carrying. Clothing: robes of dark iron-grey silk with short sleeves, an ember-red inner collar crossed at the neck, a black silk apron embroidered with small gold sparks; a basket-strap across both shoulders, the groove it has worn paler than the cloth around it; an iron thumb-ring; dust-grey boots. Hands and objects: a cord thick with small knots wound round the left wrist and held up in the foreground; the right hand holds a notched tally stick; two empty baskets at his feet. Power: a thin warm-gold glimmer of metal qi clings to the knots of the cord. Background: a stony slope in drifting smoke, a line of tiny carriers with baskets climbing a switchback, heavy dark clouds massing. Light: low grey moonlit dusk from the upper left, the forge's far red glow above as a soft rim. Expression: eyes narrowed in wary thought, lips pressed; a man who has twice been told to dig faster and has not said what he thinks.

people.imagined: The anvil hall at the end of a heat; he tilts his good right ear toward the viewer because the left has been deaf for forty years.
people.subject: The moment: the anvil hall at the end of a heat; he leans on a hammer shaft and turns his good right ear toward the viewer with a scowl, as if he did not hear, because the left ear has been deaf for forty years. Face: a heavy, flat face of fifty-five; a beard singed to a straight flat line along the jaw, as though cut with a rule; a short broad nose with open pores full of soot; small hard black eyes; thick grey brows; a cruel set mouth; skin red from fire; a scorched pale patch at the left temple. Hair: grey, cropped short and thin, under a small iron hair-crown. Body: very thick, wide chest, thick neck, arms like logs, the hammer-shoulder dropped lower. Clothing: dark iron-grey and ember-red silk robes with short sleeves baring heavy forearms, a black silk forge apron embroidered with gold sparks, scorched at its edges, leather wrist-guards, an iron thumb-ring; heavy boots. Hands and objects: a black hammer with its head resting on his shoulder; blackened nails; knuckles scarred and cracked. Power: a dull orange-gold sheen of metal qi crawls along the hammer head and his forearms. Background: a dim forge hall in rising smoke, the red glow of a furnace mouth, the curve of an anvil, a rack of tongs on the wall. Light: orange forge-glow from the lower left, cool spirit-light on the upper left. Expression: a flat, fixed scowl and hard small eyes that wait, counting the folds in a blade for the one short of nine.

people.imagined: Bright morning in the yard with a letter to his father; he looks up from the page; his skin has no scars at all.
people.subject: The moment: a bright morning in the forge yard; he stands with a folded letter in his hand and looks up mildly from it at the viewer, as he does when his father writes about the halberd. Face: a smooth, scarless, mild young face of twenty, which is strange among smiths: pale clear skin without a single burn mark; soft brown eyes; level brows; a small gentle smile; a round chin; a faint ink smudge at the thumb. Hair: black, neatly combed and tied up with a plain silk cord and a small iron pin. Body: slender and upright, narrow-chested beside the heavy men behind him. Clothing: graceful dark iron-grey silk robes with ember-red piping, sleeves rolled to show clean unmarked forearms, a spotless black silk forge apron embroidered with fine gold sparks, an iron thumb-ring, clean boots. Hands and objects: a letter folded in thirds in the left hand (no writing visible); a small hammer in the right, its handle polished pale; a case of chisels at his sash. Power: a very faint gold shimmer of metal qi at the hammer head. Background: a stone yard with a forge wall and tall chimney, a coal heap, a pale morning sky streaked with smoke, two heavy smiths blurred in a doorway. Light: clear silver-gold morning light from the upper left, a soft glow on his clean cheek. Expression: soft, patient and withheld, the face of a boy who has been left behind and does not complain, his smile holding still while the eyes read the letter again.

people.imagined: At the polishing wheel, her heel taps out of time on the treadle, and a smear of grey paste across her cheek like a seal.
people.subject: The moment: at the foot-treadle polishing wheel; her heel taps out of time on the treadle, and she turns her head with a quick bright grin at the viewer, a smear of paste across her cheek. Face: a quick, eager face of twenty-two; a broad stripe of grey-pink polishing paste smeared across one cheek and worn like a seal; sharp bright brown eyes; a pointed chin; thin lively brows; a small gap in the front teeth. Hair: black, in two buns held by small iron pins, a speck of paste in them. Body: small and bouncy, one foot on the treadle. Clothing: robes of dark iron-grey silk with ember-red collars crossed at the neck and short sleeves, a black silk apron embroidered with gold sparks and stained pale pink at the front; a light cloth tied over the lower face and pulled down to her neck; an iron thumb-ring; boots. Hands and objects: a half-polished sword blade held flat in both hands against the wheel, its half bright as a mirror and half still dull; a tin of pumice paste beside her. Power: a soft silver-gold shimmer of metal qi runs along the bright half of the blade. Background: a polishing shed in drifting dust, blades hanging on a rack, a sack of pumice. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left, a bright gleam off the blade lighting her face. Expression: an impatient, merry grin, her lips moving as she mouths a verse under her breath, already eager for the next blade.

people.imagined: Standing in the coal yard, hands spread to show black creases like inked lines, asking again for the tongs.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight in the coal yard, both palms turned up toward the viewer, she asks, as she does every week, whether a daughter may carry the tongs. Face: a stubborn little face of sixteen with a firm jaw; wide honest dark eyes; soot on the nose; her chin lifted; chapped lips; a smudge of black on one eyebrow. Hair: a short black braid with ash in it, a scrap of red thread tied at the end. Body: small, wiry and braced like a mule, though her arms tremble from the effort of asking. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of dark iron-grey silk with short sleeves, an ember-red under-collar, a small black silk apron embroidered with a few gold sparks, clean though darkened at the hem; a basket-strap wound round her shoulder; scuffed boots; a bruise the size of a thumb on her bare ankle. Hands and objects: both palms held out, coal ground so deep that every crease looks inked in black, a pale pink blister forming under the pole's grip; a carrying pole leaning on her shoulder with a basket of coal lumps hanging from it, a scrap of red cloth tied to its end, her brother's gift. Power: none. Background: a coal yard in a haze of smoke, stacked baskets, a mule, a black heap; a taller smith in a black apron walks past without looking. Light: hazy silver light from the upper left with a faint ember glow behind. Expression: chin high and eyes wide and steady, a hard-held hope that will not let her look away.

people.imagined: At the mine gate selling to a buyer, he flicks his cuff so the little bell rings.
people.subject: The moment: at the mine gate selling to a buyer; he shakes his sleeve so that a tiny brass bell at the cuff rings, and flashes a gap-toothed grin at the viewer, with a short rough bar of dark iron on his open palm. Face: a handsome, sly face of twenty-six; a wide gap-toothed grin; bright confident eyes; a neat thin moustache; a small dimple; the buyer's hand just visible at the frame's edge reaching for the bar. Hair: oiled black hair in a topknot tied with a bright silk cord and an iron pin. Body: slim, preening, leaning in toward the buyer; behind him on a cart sits a row of grey ingots tied with red cord, each stamped with a small star-shape mark (no writing). Clothing: a too-fine bright blue silk brocade coat over his iron-grey sect robe with ember-red collars, wide sleeves, a small brass bell sewn at the right cuff, a black silk apron worn open as a token, a pouch heavy with coppers swinging at his sash; polished blue-black boots. Hands and objects: a short sword in a scabbard of blue silk at his sash, his own first forging; a rough bar of dark iron held out on the open left palm as if it sang; the right hand lifts the belled cuff, the bell with a tiny bright dent. Power: a thin line of star-silver metal qi hums on the bar. Background: a mine gate in mist with a cart, ore baskets, a rough mountain. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a confident, flashing grin with eyes that size the buyer up; a man who can tell how star iron sings without having heard it.

people.imagined: Swinging the third hammer left-handed at the anvil, red cloth round the right wrist, glaring at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: he swings a hammer left-handed over the anvil and glares at the viewer, jaw set, because he said the Rite would leave the mountain with the steppe boy and carried coal for a month for it. Face: a narrow, hard boy's face of eighteen; fierce dark brows; angry bright eyes; a bruise yellowing on one cheek; sweat; a faint down on the lip; sweat drops from his chin onto the anvil and hisses; the older smith with the singed beard is a blurred dark shape at the edge of the frame, watching the beat. Hair: black, cropped, a rag round the brow soaked dark. Body: wiry, broad-shouldered for his age. Clothing: the simplest dark iron-grey silk robe with short sleeves, ember-red collar, a black silk forge apron with a few gold sparks, a thick wrist-guard on the left, heavy boots; his left forearm ridged with veins and a half-healed burn along the outer edge. Hands and objects: the right wrist wrapped in a strip of bright red cloth with a tail of thread that flutters in the heat; the left hand grips a hammer high above a glowing bar; a bucket of black water steams beside the anvil and a basket of coal waits as his month's penance. Power: a few ember-gold sparks of metal qi spiral up from the bar. Background: anvil, sparks, a red glow, a bigger smith's shadow behind. Light: orange forge-glow from the lower right, white spark flecks. Expression: furious, narrow-eyed and unyielding, the teeth set as he brings the hammer down.

people.imagined: He is listening to a blade before he looks at it, eyes closed, head tilted, a thumbnail flicked against the edge.
people.subject: The moment: in the forge hall he listens to a blade before looking at it; eyes closed, head tilted, he flicks the blade with a thumbnail beside his ear, then opens his eyes on the viewer. Face: a short, thick, strong face of fifty-five; a scorched, red-brown beard curling in rust-coloured wires; face and forearms speckled white with a hundred tiny spark scars, each the size of a grain of rice; heavy brows singed pale; deep-set dark eyes; sun-red skin. Hair: iron-grey, short, under an iron crown on a red-gold band. Body: short and very thick, a smith's chest and shoulders. Clothing: as head of the gate, the sheet's richest dress: black brocade robes embroidered with molten-gold flames and sparks in several crossed layers, hanging open over iron-grey silk, wide sleeves, a black silk apron edged in red-gold, small iron rings sewn along the collar that click faintly and catch a dull orange reflection, an iron thumb-ring; boots. Hands and objects: a plain bare sword blade with a faint blue-white shimmer held up by his ear; a branding iron glowing dull red at his sash; on the anvil beside him lie two other blades laid by length. Power: a strong aura of molten gold and ember-red qi swells round his shoulders, heat shimmering the air, sparks rising like fireflies. Background: a smoky forge hall in shadow, a distant red glow, an anvil, a rack of blades. Light: orange glow from the lower left, a thin cool light on the blade from the upper left. Expression: eyes just opening, steady and unhurried, a face still tuned to the sound of the steel.

people.imagined: Standing in his black apron at the doorway of the anvil hall, holding the coal ration slip; faintly proud.
people.subject: The moment: he stands in the doorway of the anvil hall with arms folded, looking down his nose at the viewer, a coal ration slip crumpled in one fist. Face: a strong, regular face of fifty like his father's but unscarred; smooth ruddy skin; cold, certain dark eyes; thin sharp brows; a short neat beard; a lifted chin; a thin white line of scar across his left thumb. Hair: black with grey, combed back and bound with a black silk cord and a small iron crown. Body: short, thick, powerful, standing square, thumbs hooked into the apron strings. Clothing: dark iron-grey silk robes with ember-red borders in crossed layers and short sleeves, a black iron-thread apron soft with age and spotless, its edges gone dull brown with one neat seam his father sewed, an iron thumb-ring, polished boots; at his sash a heavy key on a cord, the key to the coal store. Hands and objects: a plain forged sword in a black scabbard at his hip beside the key; arms folded; blackened nails; the coal slip crumpled in one fist; a heavy hammer on a hook behind him; a cracked coal-scuttle empty by the door. Power: a restrained cold iron-grey sheen of metal qi lies about his shoulders. Background: the dark doorway of a forge hall and an anvil, a rack of finished halberd blades; two apprentices hammer a long bar in rhythm behind him. Light: red forge-glow from behind, hard cold light from the upper left. Expression: a lifted chin and a cool, certain stare, thin lips set; he looks as though every answer is already his.

people.imagined: Dawn, knee-deep in the snow-melt pool with blue-white hands held out of the water, not seeming to feel the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn, knee-deep in the snow-melt pool below the forge, he holds a pair of long black tongs in both blue-white hands and looks at the viewer, quite still, as if the cold did not touch him. Face: a long, thin, old face of sixty-five; skin blue-white like a drowned man's; thin grey-white eyebrows; pale blue-grey eyes; a pinched mouth with bluish-grey lips; a sparse white beard with faint frost on it; he exhales visible vapour though the morning is mild. Hair: thin white hair knotted behind with an iron pin. Body: thin, narrow and bent at the shoulders. Clothing: flowing iron-grey and pale ember-red silk layers with a crossed collar, a black silk apron with faint gold sparks, sleeves pushed above the elbow, trousers rolled above the knee and wet, a scarf of grey silk. Hands and objects: bloodless blue-white hands with knuckles swollen by old cold, gripping the black iron River Tongs, worn smooth; a sword blade half-submerged where he has just quenched it, steam coiling; a small cup of tea untouched and cooling on the stone edge. Power: a pale frost-blue sheen of water qi in the pool around his legs and wisps of cold mist coiling about the tongs. Background: a pale ice-blue pool with a thin ring of rime on its stone lip, a little floating ice, wisps of mist; a coal-carrier's girl small and far off at the frame's edge watching the tongs. Light: cold blue-white moonlit dawn from the upper left. Expression: a hooded, remote gaze with the pale eyes steady and the pinched mouth shut, a withdrawn old man who loves what he alone can do.

people.imagined: At the mine head, shaking a pair of dice in her fist and laughing as a tally dispute is settled.
people.subject: The moment: at the mine head, a tally dispute among diggers is settled by dice; she shakes two bone dice in her fist beside her ear, laughing loudly, and winks at the viewer. Face: a broad, laughing, weathered face of forty-eight; a wide mouth showing many teeth; crinkled bright eyes; fine iron-grey dust sparkling in her hair and eyebrows; ruddy cheeks. Hair: thick brown-grey hair twisted into a heavy knot, dusted with iron, held by an iron pin. Body: broad, strong and sturdy. Clothing: dark iron-grey and ember-red silk robes in layered crossed collars with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a black silk apron embroidered with gold sparks, a sash with a bundle of notched tally sticks, silk leggings and ore-grey boots; round her neck on a cord a small iron nail she calls luck; an extra tally stick behind her ear. Hands and objects: a short broad sword in a scabbard at her sash, ore-dusted; a fist holding two worn bone dice, one corner chipped, up by her ear; broad hands with short nails rimmed with grey ore dust. Power: a faint warm-gold gleam of metal qi dances among the dice and nail. Background: a mine-head scaffold with rope ladders and a bucket on a pulley in mist, a line of diggers, grey mountain; two diggers crouch over a dispute scratched in the dust and wait, grinning, for her throw. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a gregarious, mischievous laugh with a hard bright sharpness in the winking eye, as if she knows already how the dice will fall.

people.imagined: Winter dusk, bare-chested at the forge, laughing at the falling snow while a bright blade glows orange in his tongs.
people.subject: The moment: winter dusk; bare-chested at the forge he laughs at the falling snow while a bright blade glows orange in his tongs, turning to the viewer with a wide laugh, steam rising from his shoulders. Face: a lean, sun-dark, handsome face of thirty-five; a wide laugh; white teeth; black eyes with a fierce spark; a strong nose; stubble; sweat; a faded red cloth band holds the sweat back on his brow. Hair: black, loose and tousled to the shoulder, a thong at the brow. Body: lean, muscular and sinewy; snow collects on his bare shoulders and melts instantly into steam; his arms marked with fine pale spark scars, fewer than the older smiths'; behind him in shadow a thick-set old smith with a burnt beard watches. Clothing: an iron-grey silk robe pulled down and knotted at the waist in the smiths' way, a black silk apron embroidered with gold sparks tied low, an iron thumb-ring, a pouch of steppe salt at his sash, boots; a clay jug of strong millet wine stands on the anvil with its stopper off. Hands and objects: tongs holding a sword blade glowing orange-red, held up high; snowflakes melting on his skin. Power: strong scarlet and gold fire qi curls round the blade and his forearms, sparks and ember-motes streaming upward into the snow. Background: a forge mouth, snow in the air, grey mountain. Light: orange glow from below on his face, cold blue snow-light from the upper left. Expression: a roaring, fearless laugh, impatient and open-handed, the eyes bright with the fire.

people.imagined: In the yard carrying her own coal ration across to her grandfather's forge, glancing up with half a brow.
people.subject: The moment: crossing the forge yard with a coal basket on her hip, she stops and looks sidelong at the viewer, carrying her own ration to her grandfather's forge. Face: a square, determined face of twenty-three with her grandfather's jaw; one eyebrow missing entirely, the skin smooth and paler where it was burned off, the other brow thick and dark; brave brown eyes; a set mouth. Hair: black, braided and pinned up with an iron pin. Body: sturdy, short, squared; a dusting of coal dust on her shoulders. Clothing: dark iron-grey silk robes with ember-red crossed collars and short sleeves, a black silk apron embroidered with gold sparks, a basket-strap, boots. Hands and objects: a small sword she has forged herself, in a cloth scabbard at her sash; a small basket of black coal on her hip, covered with a scrap of cloth to keep it from her father's eye, her free hand holding its rim; a small half-healed burn blister on her left wrist. Power: a tiny, warm ember-red glimmer of returned fire qi sits in the coal beneath the cloth. Background: a stone yard with a forge chimney in smoke; across the yard her grandfather's forge door stands open with a dull red glow, and her father's tall black-aproned figure is a distant dark shape at the opposite door, his back turned. Light: clear silver light from the upper left, the ember glow of the open forge on the near cheek. Expression: a stubborn sidelong look, brave and steady, lips set, the eyes daring anyone to tell her father.

people.imagined: With the coal pole across his neck, answering to his name on the second try with a puzzled look.
people.subject: The moment: with the coal pole across his neck he answers to his name on the second try, scratching his head with one hand and squinting slightly in the sun, puzzled, wondering what he was promised. Face: a broad, easy, puzzled boy's face of seventeen; mild round eyes; the mouth slightly open; a smudge of soot on one cheek. Hair: short black, standing up. Body: strong, thick-necked and stooped under the pole, a thick callus ridge running across the nape like a rope. Clothing: the simplest clean dark iron-grey silk tunic and an ember-red vest with short sleeves, sturdy trousers, boots tied with cord at the toe; a small child's wooden hammer toy tucked in his sash, a gift from his sister; a purple bruise on one shin. Hands and objects: a plain apprentice's practice sword in a cloth scabbard tied across his back; the pole smooth and dark with sweat across his shoulders, a deep groove worn in the wood where it sits and a basket hanging at each end; one hand over the pole, the other scratching his head. Power: none. Background: a coal road in a haze of smoke, the baskets swinging and spilling a few black lumps, far peaks in mist. Light: hazy silver light from the upper left, a faint warm ember glow low on the horizon. Expression: a blank, mild, slightly baffled look, the brows drawn together and the mouth open, a good-natured boy who will do whatever he is told and is rarely quite sure what it was.

people.imagined: Low-voiced in the polishing house, holding a blade to catch the moon; she pours tea at the same time.
people.subject: The moment: low-voiced in the polishing house; she holds a polished blade tilted to catch the lamp like a moon, and lowers her eyes calmly to the viewer. Face: a calm, smooth oval face of thirty-one; soft dark eyes; level brows; a small gentle mouth, the lips slightly parted as if about to whisper; the blade she holds is so bright that the room's lamp, a window and her own calm face show in it as small curved pictures. Hair: black, in a low knot, pinned with a plain silver pin. Body: slender and composed. Clothing: graceful dark iron-grey silk robes with ember-red inner collars crossed at the neck, sleeves tied back with silk cord, a spotless black silk apron embroidered with fine gold sparks; her fingertips smooth and pink from pumice. Hands and objects: a mirror-bright blade held by its tang across both palms with a soft cloth, reflecting a pale round gleam; a small tea bowl at her knee; on a low table beside her a pot of tea with two bowls, one for an old man who has not yet come. Power: a soft moon-silver sheen of metal and water qi gathers on the blade like a second reflection. Background: a quiet shed in gentle dust motes, racks of blades, a sack of fine pumice and a box of soft cloths behind her. Light: soft lamplight from the upper left blended with a cool moonlike glow off the blade. Expression: calm, lowered eyes and a patient, humble half-smile, the face of one who listens more than she speaks.

people.imagined: At the forge door with a cup of wine for a factor; shows an ink-stained thumbnail and new boots.
people.subject: The moment: at the forge door with a cup of wine for a factor; he holds it out to the viewer with an eager smile, ink-stained thumb up. Face: a bright, round, eager face of twenty-one; clean-shaven; quick eyes; a thin moustache fuzz; his cheeks pink from the climb up the mountain track. Hair: brown, neat, parted and oiled, held with a small silver pin. Body: medium, upright, a little puffed; he stands slightly on tiptoe to look taller; behind him a factor in a fur-trimmed coat is blurred, half-turned. Clothing: clean dark iron-grey silk robes with ember-red borders and a starched pale gauze collar a little too high, a clean black silk apron with tiny gold sparks, a tiny ink blot on one cuff; good polished boots with brass eyelets that look new and a size too ambitious for a forge yard. Hands and objects: a slim sword in a lacquered scabbard at his sash, still bright from the shop; a small clay cup of wine in one hand; on the other an ink-blackened thumbnail clearly shown, a smudge of ink down the side of his finger; a bundle of oilcloth-wrapped complaints under one arm. Power: none. Background: a forge gate and mountain in drifting smoke and pale mist. Light: bright silvery light from the upper left, a warm glow from the forge door. Expression: a bright, eager smile, wide eyes and a hopeful tilt of the head, anxious to please and sure he is liked.

people.imagined: Weighing a lump of ore in her palm, eyes narrowed, a handful of rice weighed on the other hand.
people.subject: The moment: weighing a lump of ore in her palm, eyes narrowed; she looks suspiciously at the viewer. Face: a thin, wary face of twenty-seven; narrowed dark eyes; thin pressed lips; black iron dust in the creases of her cheeks; a streak of black dust across her forehead where she has wiped sweat; she weighs it up and down as though counting, lips moving. Hair: black, short and tied up with an iron pin. Body: wiry and tense, hunched with her left hand curled round a few grains of rice as if protecting them. Clothing: dark iron-grey silk robes with ember-red crossed collars and short sleeves, a black silk apron embroidered with gold sparks; on the bench behind her stand baskets of ore, the star mine's lot set apart under a cloth that she has not been allowed to lift; her rice bowl rests on a shelf with a small cloth pouch. Hands and objects: a plain short sword hung at her sash by a cord; black iron dust under every nail; a rough dark ore lump with a faint orange rust-scale on one palm and a few grains of rice on the other. Power: a faint cool star-silver glimmer of metal qi on the ore lump. Background: a mine shed with ore baskets, drifting dust and soft smoke. Light: dim cool spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on her cheek. Expression: a narrowed, suspicious stare and silently moving lips, counting everything twice and trusting nothing she has not weighed.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder, as painted on the gate wall: lean, white-browed, snow melting on his shoulders.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder, as painted on the gate wall, faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened: a lean man stands in snow with a pair of black tongs, looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, hard face of sixty with white eyebrows that glow against the aged brown skin; deep lines; stern pale eyes; a long chin. Hair: grey-white, tied back with an iron crown-pin; behind him a narrow river shows as a pale blue ribbon below the peaks, and a second smaller figure, the first quench-keeper, stands knee-deep in it with a pair of tongs. Body: lean, tall, spare. Clothing: as founder, the sheet's richest dress, faded with age: black brocade robes embroidered with molten-gold flames in crossed layers, an iron crown, a heavy silk apron over iron-grey silk; snow lies thick on the apron and on both shoulders and a thin stream of melt runs from them. Hands and objects: a pair of black tongs raised, a glowing bar between them, a thin line of faded orange. Power: a faint, faded gold-and-ember aura round the tongs and shoulders, as old pigment. Background: snow peaks and a pool; the wall painting has pale plaster cracks across it, flakes of old red lacquer, a pale grey-green plaster ground with an old sooty smear along its lower edge from centuries of forge smoke. Light: faded, pale, yellowed like old pigment. Expression: a stern, severe, upright look with pale eyes held steady, a devout man who asks as much of the fire as of himself.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the old smith, one shoulder lower than the other after sixty years at the anvil.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened: a stooped old smith stands with his right shoulder dropped, looking quietly at the viewer. Face: a kind, weathered face of eighty; a thin white beard; gentle eyes, soft and a little wet; deep creases. Hair: white, thin, under a small faded iron crown. Body: one shoulder visibly lower than the other, stooped; his dropped right shoulder pulls the whole body into a gentle slant; a thin crack runs through the old silk down the middle of the portrait, repaired with a strip of paper on the back, and dark foxing spots dapple the edges. Clothing: as an elder smith, faded black brocade robes embroidered with dim molten-gold sparks over grey silk, with a black silk apron scorched at the hem and smoothed pale at the front where he leaned on the anvil for sixty years. Hands and objects: a small hammer in his right hand held at his side. Power: a faint, old gold glow of metal qi at the hammer head, nearly gone. Background: a dim forge in soft smoke; faintly behind him on the wall, the outline of a long halberd with a curved blade is hung in lighter paint. Light: faded warm light, yellowed like old pigment. Expression: a quiet, humble, gentle gaze with the faintest smile, a man at peace with a long day's work.
